title: UWell Caliburn A3 Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust quantity to the desired number.
The UWell Caliburn A3 Replacement Pod is designed specifically for UWell Caliburn A3 Pod Vape Device and the UWell Caliburn AK3 Pod Vape Device.
The pod has an e-liquid capacity of 2ml. Each pod is refillable and thanks to its top-fill design, you can fille-iquid at any time.
The 1.0ohm Pod Coil can provide a slightly warmer vaping experience for you because it does have lower coil resistance and the device will output more wattage.
2ml capacity
